chunks: We have not created the heavens and the earth and all that lies between them but with a purpose for an appointed time. Yet the unbelievers turn away from the warning.
ai.seo_question: What is the purpose of creation according to Surah Al-Dhariyat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'al-haqq' is interpreted not merely as truth but as the ultimate reality of divine wisdom and the establishment of the Ma'rifah (gnosis) of Allah, while 'ajal musamma' signifies the fixed term for both the cosmic cycle and the resurrection. This verse underscores the futility of worldly existence for those who ignore the prophetic warning, a theme central to the Shia understanding of the Hereafter and the purpose of creation as a test for spiritual ascent.
